apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: harbor}
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: harbor}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: harbor}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: harbor-service:lab
          imagePullPolicy: Never
          ports: [{name: http, containerPort: 8080}]
